The Alldocube iPlay 80 Mini Ultra is a compact Android tablet with something most others in this segment don’t offer — full cellular support. But does that make it worth considering?
In this video, we take a closer look at the iPlay 80 Mini Ultra — its 8.8” display, Dimensity 8300 performance, battery life, speakers, software, and real-world usage — to see who this tablet is actually for. It’s not the most powerful compact tablet out there, but it brings a unique advantage that might make all the difference.
